widened.summary: The per-case training loss as a bounded, declarative expression over battery's registered loss terms, in place of the fixed objective menu (the GA-D6 core). Carbon validates, canonicalizes and pins it, and builds the loss with its own code.
Adds sub, neg, exp and constant leaves, which can make a loss negative or non-finite. Attack panel only, never a valid surface.
